note: sha256 of every file fetched by data/astro/fetch.py, measured on 2026-11-07 from the hosts named in results/astro/data_access.md. fetch.py verifies against this file and records a new entry on first download of an unlisted key.

frame_r_decompressed.note: bunzip2 of sdss_frame_r; byte-identical to the frame-r file shipped in the public repository named multiband_pcat (cmp)

frame_g_decompressed.note: byte-identical to the frame-g file shipped in the repository named multiband_pcat (cmp)

frame_i_decompressed.note: byte-identical to the frame-i file shipped in the repository named multiband_pcat (cmp)

patch_x310_y630_stats.note: DN statistics of extract-patch output (frame/cal + interpolated sky), rows 630..729, columns 310..409, 0-based

shipped_inputs.note: four small text files shipped in the public git repository named lion (not in this repo); fetched by `fetch.py shipped` with ASTRO_LION_GIT_URL set. Same bytes are in the repository named multiband_pcat under Data/sdss.0921/ (cmp).
shipped_inputs.commit_note: last commit dated 2021-01-13, before a burst of generic-message commits dated 2026-09-08; the four files are byte-identical at the commit that first added them (2018-06-18), at this commit and at the 2026 HEAD (5f0f3257490a351dc9ce1745aac17b16383ff0f3)

Data/sdss0921_cntp.txt.meaning: 100x100 raw counts (bias included), row-major, rows = frame rows

Data/sdss0921_pixl.txt.meaning: line 1: width height nbands; line 2: bias gain (1044. 4.62)

Data/sdss0921_psfn.txt.meaning: line 1: stamp size, oversampling (25 5); then a 125x125 array

Data/sdss0921_true.txt.meaning: 6048 rows: x y flux in patch pixels / SDSS counts; mag = 22.5 - 2.5 log10(flux * 0.00546689)

references_read.note: files read to write results/astro/m2_field_spec.md; not fetched by fetch.py (arXiv may re-render these on a new version, so they are not verified)
